19: @[expose] public section
20: 
21: open Module
22: 
23: namespace Ideal
24: 
25: variable {ι R S : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommRing S] [IsDomain S] [Algebra R S]
26: 
27: /-- A basis on `S` gives a basis on `Ideal.span {x}`, by multiplying everything by `x`. -/
28: noncomputable def basisSpanSingleton (b : Basis ι R S) {x : S} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
29:     Basis ι R (span ({x} : Set S)) :=
30:   b.map <|
31:     LinearEquiv.ofInjective (LinearMap.mulLeft R x) (mul_right_injective₀ hx) ≪≫ₗ
32:         LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _
33:           (by
34:             ext
35:             simp [mem_span_singleton', mul_comm]) ≪≫ₗ
36:       (Submodule.restrictScalarsEquiv R S S (Ideal.span ({x} : Set S))).restrictScalars R
37: 
38: @[simp]
39: theorem basisSpanSingleton_apply (b : Basis ι R S) {x : S} (hx : x ≠ 0) (i : ι) :
40:     (basisSpanSingleton b hx i : S) = x * b i := by
41:   simp only [basisSpanSingleton, Basis.map_apply, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
42:     Submodule.restrictScalarsEquiv_apply, LinearEquiv.ofInjective_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_ofEq_apply,
43:     LinearEquiv.restrictScalars_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply]
44: 
45: @[simp]
46: theorem constr_basisSpanSingleton {N : Type*} [Semiring N] [Module N S] [SMulCommClass R N S]
47:     (b : Basis ι R S) {x : S} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
48:     (b.constr N).toFun (((↑) : _ → S) ∘ (basisSpanSingleton b hx)) = Algebra.lmul R S x :=
49:   b.ext fun i => by simp
50: 
51: end Ideal
52: 
53: /-- If `I : Ideal S` has a basis over `R`,
54: `x ∈ I` iff it is a linear combination of basis vectors. -/
55: theorem Basis.mem_ideal_iff {ι R S : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring S] [Algebra R S]
56:     {I : Ideal S} (b : Basis ι R I) {x : S} :
57:     x ∈ I ↔ ∃ c : ι →₀ R, x = Finsupp.sum c fun i x => x • (b i : S) :=
58:   (b.map ((I.restrictScalarsEquiv R _ _).restrictScalars R).symm).mem_submodule_iff
59: 
60: /-- If `I : Ideal S` has a finite basis over `R`,
61: `x ∈ I` iff it is a linear combination of basis vectors. -/
62: theorem Basis.mem_ideal_iff' {ι R S : Type*} [Fintype ι] [CommSemiring R] [Semiring S] [Algebra R S]
63:     {I : Ideal S} (b : Basis ι R I) {x : S} : x ∈ I ↔ ∃ c : ι → R, x = ∑ i, c i • (b i : S) :=
64:   (b.map ((I.restrictScalarsEquiv R _ _).restrictScalars R).symm).mem_submodule_iff'

    constructor
